provenance.afterSource: Uncommitted working tree; modified/new source hashes identify this implementation.

microbenchmark: Production provider publication, synchronization, snapshots and ray extraction.
Eight warmup calls; timing is median of seven batched means, without allocation counting.
Separate warmed allocation pass counts cumulative requested C++ new bytes, not peak/live/GPU memory.
Both variants use the same malloc-backed global allocation overrides.
Inputs are immutable and prepared outside the measurement; historical BIM manager topology/count/bounds scans are excluded.
The after statistics/budget queries report warmed cache-hit behavior.
Iteration counts adapt to each path; checksums across before/after are not comparable.
native: No temporal capture sequence; timing remains within drawFrame.
Discard frames below 20 and any screenshot frame.
nonWaitFrameMs = Frame minus Screenshot, Present, Frame wait, Image fence, Acquire image; this is elapsed CPU work, not CPU utilization.
Rendering identity uses scene counts, source, camera, import fields, exact scene-only PNG comparison; temporal object identity is covered by native lifecycle/unit tests.
No build, benchmark or CPU test processes ran concurrently with native timing captures.
Eight before/after configurations, 99 warmed non-screenshot frames per configuration.
Only name, active and status define pass topology; GPU timestamp-readiness is asynchronous.
Open-UI images contain variable timing text and are excluded from exact pixel comparisons.
